entry.title: Palace of Culture and Science
entry.note: Exact-QID concave complex outline and two courtyard holes retained. Congress Hall is on the mapped rounded native+Z lobe, fixing the signed facade axis and east-facing main entrance. Central shaft is reconstructed at native[0,-18] inside that aligned complex. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
